title: Grateful Dead Live at Seattle Center Coliseum on 1982-08-29
lineage: FOB) Nak 300/CP4 > Cm > Dat > Sound Forge > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with decent clarity; a short, generic show that shines on tight playing and moments like “He’s Gone” and “Sugar Magnolia”.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an audience (AUD) source that sounds better than expected – high‑end sparkle but occasional annoying hiss. Musically the concert is modest, with a short, unexciting setlist, yet the band stays tight, Jerry sings well for ’82, Brent’s keys are on fire and the post‑drums/NFA jam plus “He’s Gone” and “Sugar Magnolia” stand out.

ai_rating.rationale: Average to good show quality with several tight moments, balanced by a generally dull setlist; recording is solid for an audience source but not pristine, leading to a mid‑high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Better than expected for an AUD; clear high‑end sparkle yet some annoying hiss/annoyances noted by reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short and generic set that felt a bit dull, but the band stayed focused and tight throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: In good voice for ’82, focused and intense performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) was on fire during this show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Post‑drums/NFA segment described as brooding, nasty and a highlight.
